parameters.name: DatasetName
parameters.description: The name of the dataset. You can obtain the name of the dataset from the response of the [CreateDataset](~~478160~~) operation.

parameters.name: ProjectName
parameters.description: The name of the project. You can obtain the name of the project from the response of the [CreateProject](~~478153~~) operation.

parameters.name: URIs
parameters.description: The URIs of the OSS buckets in which the files whose metadata you want to delete are stored. You can specify up to 100 URIs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun imm batch-delete-file-meta --project-name test-project --dataset-name test-dataset --ur-is oss://test-bucket/test-object --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
